summary:
禮來受惠於強勁的肥胖與糖尿病藥物需求，第二季營收與每股盈餘皆大幅優於市場預期。
• 第二季營收達 22.97 億美元，年增率高達 47.67%
• 受惠於 Mounjaro 與 Zepbound 銷售動能強勁
• 每股盈餘（EPS）繳出 8.38 美元佳績，大幅優於預估
• 本益比維持在 37.53 倍反映市場的高成長期待
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現強勁的營收成長與獲利能力，訊號偏向極為正面。對中短期股價具備強力支撐，反映基本面無虞。後續應追蹤產能擴充進度、新藥研發進展及毛利率變化。

需留意：產能擴張速度是否能持續追上爆發性的市場需求；高估值面臨的潛在股價波動與修正壓力；未來面臨來自同業在減重藥物市場的競爭加劇

summary_en:
Eli Lilly reported a significant beat on Q2 revenue and EPS, driven by robust demand for obesity and diabetes treatments.
• Q2 revenue reached $22.97 billion, representing a 47.67% YoY growth
• Strong sales momentum driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound
• EPS came in at $8.38, significantly beating consensus estimates
• Trailing PE of 37.53 reflects high market expectations for future growth

view: The earnings report demonstrates robust revenue growth and profitability, signaling a strongly positive outlook. This provides solid support for near-to-mid-term stock performance, reflecting strong underlying fundamentals. Key metrics to track include manufacturing capacity expansion, clinical pipeline progress, and gross margin trends.

Watch：Manufacturing capacity keeping pace with surging market demand; Potential volatility and correction pressure due to high valuation multiples; Increasing competitive pressures in the weight-loss drug market
